title: Unencrypted SQLite Database Storing Biometric Templates and PIN Hashes
description: The application opens a standard unencrypted SQLite database via `openDatabase('auth_vault.db', ...)` to store parental control PIN hashes and biometric verification metadata without SQLCipher encryption.
attack_vector: An attacker pulls `auth_vault.db` from device storage to perform offline GPU hash cracking on the PIN or overwrite the row with a known PIN hash to bypass parental lock screens.
fix_rationale: Use `sqflite_sqlcipher` with a 256-bit encryption key retrieved from `FlutterSecureStorage` (`openDatabase(..., password: dbEncryptionKey)`).
